research_memory.findings: The GOST source lists 108 mm as a standard outside diameter; the pipe source identifies DN 108×3.5 as DN 100. The plan limits conversion to explicit OD context and this single documented mapping.

research_memory.question: Does the 30с41нж designation define a flanged, wedge-gate, rising-stem DN/PN class that has a technically equivalent LD catalog family, rather than only a superficially similar gate valve?
research_memory.findings: Reject the premise of an LD-family equivalence. 30с41нж is a steel wedge-gate family at PN 1.6 MPa (PN16), offered across DN sizes; manufacturer documentation identifies its flanged version and wedge construction. One manufacturer explicitly calls it flanged with a rising stem. However, the supplied LD catalog contains no gate-valve products: its only names containing «задвижк» are six LD Стриж ball valves described as «под задвижку», all with interflange connections. A ball valve, even at matching DN/PN, is not technically equivalent to a flanged rising-stem wedge gate valve. Also, DN is not encoded as one fixed value in 30с41нж; it must be supplied separately.
research_memory.decision_impact: Do not add a designation-to-LD gate-valve alias or treat LD ball valves as substitutions for 30с41нж. Match only if a tender explicitly permits an alternative valve type; otherwise this is a catalog no-match for the LD corpus.
research_memory.unresolved: The designation’s exact connection configuration should still be verified against the procurement specification: the MZTA family page lists both welded and flanged connections, while the conventional 30с41нж product documentation describes the flanged rising-stem variant. This does not affect the lack of an LD wedge-gate family.

research_memory.question: What recurring real-tender failure classes suggest the next bounded hypothesis?
research_memory.findings: Derived the 130 review cases from the intact full corpus minus the 90 labels and 33 provisional cases because the provided review-pool gzip has CRC/length corruption. Main classes: (1) 71 ball-valve rows, heavily concentrated in threaded inch-size, endpoint, handle, and third-party model nomenclature (IVR/VALTEC); current canonicalization produces no meaningful retrieval alternate for these. The LD catalog contains 647 brass ball valves and itself expresses inch↔DN forms, so this is a genuine catalog-language mismatch. (2) 33 filter and many service/maintenance rows (installation, removal, repair, ТО) are requests for work, consumables, or water-treatment equipment rather than a sellable LD catalog item; retrieval should not be pushed toward an unrelated product. (3) 20 butterfly-valve rows mix generic viable requests with third-party model/designation requests; 356 LD butterfly products exist, so model text may obscure otherwise useful family/DN/PN evidence. Promising directions: additive canonicalization of unambiguous threaded endpoint spellings (ВР/НР, вн-вн) and standard inch sizes into catalog-native DN/connection vocabulary; a conservative query-intent route for explicit service/maintenance actions; and a separately bounded manufacturer/model enrichment or model-token de-emphasis experiment for third-party branded products.
research_memory.decision_impact: Prefer a retrieval-only, fail-open threaded/inch canonicalization experiment: it addresses the largest repeated viable-product class, aligns with the only previously accepted mechanism, and leaves reranking/selection unchanged. Keep service-intent routing as a distinct safety hypothesis rather than combining it, since prior selection-adjacent changes regressed. Treat external model lookup as lower-volume and higher-latency unless a later sample shows generic normalization cannot recover branded rows.
research_memory.unresolved: The review-pool gzip is corrupt locally, though the full corpus supports exact reconstruction by id count. Need evaluate whether catalog-native endpoint/inch expansion improves candidate recall without crowding out candidates; do not assume branded models are technically interchangeable. Service rows may be procurement line items that intentionally include a product, so any intent router must be explicit-action-only and conservative.

research_memory.question: What recurring real-tender classes and current-pipeline gaps should inform the next bounded hypothesis?
research_memory.findings: The intact corpus reconstructs 130 review rows (253 total minus 90 labelled and 33 provisional NOT_FOUND). Main classes: 53 ball-valve rows, including 42 threaded and 35 third-party-brand/model rows; 20 butterfly-valve rows, several branded; 33 filter rows, many cartridges/water-treatment rather than LD грязевики; and 18 explicit installation/repair/maintenance rows. The catalog has substantial ball-valve (14,433), butterfly-valve (356), and filter (129) coverage, but no matching third-party brand/model tokens (IVR, VALTEC, Tecofi, Kvant, etc.), so opaque model/order text can dominate retrieval despite otherwise usable generic requirements. Current canonicalization produces alternates for only 40/130 review rows. It also has a general lexical integrity flaw: its quantity/clause terminator can interpret the substring «ШТ.» inside a technical designation as a quantity marker, truncating «КШТ.11.050.025.ф/ф» to «Кран БИВАЛ К». The original query remains in retrieval, but the added alternate is degraded. Promising directions: (1) a bounded, additive model/order-token de-emphasis alternate that retains explicit product family, size, endpoint, material, control, and pressure facts without asserting cross-brand equivalence; (2) a generic token-boundary/quantity-parser correction so technical designations cannot be clipped; (3) separately, a conservative intent route for unambiguous service-only work or non-catalog consumables; (4) only if simpler normalization fails, runtime manufacturer/model enrichment for repeated branded families.
research_memory.decision_impact: Prefer testing retrieval-only supplier/model-noise de-emphasis, with the untouched original query retained and no inferred specifications or final-selection changes. It targets a repeated 35-row class and differs from the previously rejected endpoint/inch expansion. Treat the designation-truncation repair as a small correctness fix or separate experiment. Keep service/consumable abstention isolated: some work lines include an underlying product, and prior selection-adjacent changes were risky.
research_memory.unresolved: The review-pool gzip remains CRC-corrupt, though its intended set is exactly reconstructable from the other supplied files. Branded model strings may encode material, porting, or connection details not stated elsewhere; a de-emphasis alternate must therefore be additive and preserve all explicit non-model tokens. Filter rows need a product-vs-consumable distinction before any NOT_FOUND routing.

research_memory.question: What recurring real-tender failure classes and bounded directions should inform the next hypothesis?
research_memory.findings:
The intact corpus reconstructs the 130 review rows (253 total minus 90 labelled minus 33 provisional NOT_FOUND); the supplied review-pool gzip remains CRC-corrupt. The largest viable-looking unresolved class is branded threaded ball valves: 53 ball-valve rows, 42 with third-party brands, including 30 IVR rows. Current canonicalization emits an alternate for only 40/130 review rows, and none for representative IVR/VALTEC rows. Official manufacturer data shows the opaque IVR 954/956 codes carry material retrieval facts: full-bore threaded ball valve and F/F versus M/F endpoints; VALTEC VT.214 likewise identifies a ball valve with an internal-thread endpoint. LD has hundreds of brass threaded ball-valve products, including explicit В-В/В-Н and handle variants, so this is a real vocabulary/underspecification gap—not evidence that foreign branded products are automatically interchangeable with LD.

A separate correctness defect is confirmed: the clause terminator treats the embedded «ШТ.» in a technical designation as a quantity token, reducing «Кран БИВАЛ КШТ.11.050.025.ф/ф 50х25 КОФ» to «Кран БИВАЛ К». This should be repaired by token-boundary parsing, not a designation-specific rule. The pool also contains 33 filter/water-treatment rows and explicit work rows; many are consumables or service requests, but a few service lines embed a product, so broad abstention is unsafe.

Promising directions: (1) a bounded, fail-open runtime manufacturer/model enrichment path for extractable brand+model queries, using a trusted manufacturer source and adding only explicitly documented generic facts to an alternate retrieval query; retain the original query and final selection semantics. (2) A small generic quantity/clause-boundary correction that preserves technical designations in retrieval alternates. (3) A later conservative product-intent/uncertainty route restricted to unambiguous service-only or consumable-only queries. Do not repeat deterministic inch/endpoint expansion or generic supplier-token suppression: both have already been rejected by hidden safety gates.
research_memory.decision_impact: The strongest new product opportunity is source-backed, additive enrichment of repeated branded model nomenclature, because a model code can resolve endpoint and bore facts that the tender omits. It has external dependency, latency, caching, and source-trust costs, and must never assert LD equivalence or override reranking. If the Planner wants the lowest-risk bounded experiment instead, select the generic designation/quantity parser repair; it is a correctness fix with narrower expected corpus impact. Keep service abstention separate from either retrieval experiment.
research_memory.unresolved: Whether external enrichment improves LD candidate recall enough to justify runtime dependency is unmeasured; manufacturer documents establish source-product properties, not a suitable LD substitute. The CRC-corrupt review-pool artifact should be repaired separately, although its intended membership is reconstructable from the other corpus files.

research_memory.question: What causal mechanisms remain promising for improving real-tender LD matching after the current champion and prior experiments?
research_memory.findings: The active production path retrieves with the original query plus at most one canonical alternate, fuses dense/BM25 candidates into a fixed top-20, then reranks against the untouched original query. Canonicalization is therefore retrieval-only and fail-open. In the reconstructed 130-row review set, 53 rows mention ball valves, 50 threaded/inch-style cues, 43 third-party brands (30 IVR), 33 filter/water-treatment rows, and 11 explicit service-action rows. Only 40/130 currently receive a canonical alternate. The catalog contains 15,788 products, including substantial ball-valve and butterfly coverage, but no IVR/VALTEC/TECOFI/БИВАЛ tokens; it has no cartridge or water-treatment products, while its 129 “filter” products are principally грязевики. A confirmed parser defect truncates “Кран БИВАЛ КШТ.11.050.025.ф/ф 50х25 КОФ” to “Кран БИВАЛ К”: the clause-end quantity pattern can recognize embedded “ШТ.” without a required leading token boundary. This is a general parsing error, not a one-off rule. No new evidence supports another branded-model suppression or source-enrichment refinement: three such attempts already increased hidden wrong-NOT_FOUND rate despite retaining original-query retrieval.
research_memory.decision_impact: The main uncertainty is whether useful unresolved value is constrained by loss of query evidence during normalization and late fusion, or by genuine catalog-scope/service-consumable requests that should produce uncertainty rather than more retrieval. The Planner should distinguish these mechanisms. Do not select another endpoint/inch, branded-token suppression, or manufacturer-model enrichment variant without new causal evidence; those paths are already tested and unsafe.
research_memory.unresolved: The review corpus is unresolved rather than outcome-labeled, so its category counts establish opportunity and scope but not end-to-end uplift. The supplied review-pool gzip remains corrupt; membership is reconstructable from the intact all-rows, labels, and provisional-NOT_FOUND files. It is also unmeasured whether correcting the canonical alternate changes the final top-20, because the original query is retained and may already supply the needed candidate.

candidate_directions.causal_mechanism: Repair structural line-item/quantity boundary parsing so a canonical retrieval alternate cannot stop inside an alphanumeric technical designation; retain the raw query, all existing canonical transformations, and final reranking behavior.

candidate_directions.information_gain: High confidence in correctness and moderate information gain: it isolates whether an established successful mechanism is currently losing evidence through parsing rather than through retrieval or reranking.

candidate_directions.causal_mechanism: Represent original and canonical retrieval hits as separate evidence channels through fusion, rather than collapsing each modality to one locally best rank before RRF; reward candidates corroborated by both query forms without removing candidates or changing reranker semantics.
candidate_directions.competing_explanation: The primary limitation may be candidate absence or reranker choice, so preserving alternate-query corroboration may not alter the fixed top-20 meaningfully; candidate-composition changes have previously been risky.
candidate_directions.falsifier: On a real-tender stratification of rows with canonical alternates, variant-aware fusion does not improve family/constraint-consistent candidate presence or rank, or it breaches public/hidden coverage or safety gates.
candidate_directions.information_gain: Moderate-to-high: it tests an untried architectural implication of the accepted canonicalization mechanism while avoiding another semantic expansion or index rebuild.

candidate_directions.causal_mechanism: Use affirmative evidence of service-only procurement or a request category absent from the LD product taxonomy to route toward an uncertain/NOT_FOUND outcome, while allowing lines that name an actual purchasable product to continue through ordinary retrieval.
candidate_directions.competing_explanation: Tender work descriptions can embed an intended product, and catalog lexical fields can be noisy; a router could convert recoverable matches into wrong NOT_FOUND, reproducing prior selection-adjacent regressions.

research_memory.question: What causal mechanisms remain credible after evidence synthesis for Harness v2 attempt 2?
research_memory.findings: The current path is raw-query retrieval plus at most one canonical alternate, merged per modality by its single best variant rank, then RRF top-20 and reranking against the untouched raw query. In the reconstructed 130-row review set, 69 mention valves/cranes, 52 have threaded/inch cues, 39 contain third-party brand cues, 33 concern filters/water treatment, and 11 are explicit service actions; only 40 rows receive a canonical alternate. A real parser defect is confirmed: an embedded technical-designation substring “КШТ.” is treated as a quantity boundary and reduces one review query to “Кран БИВАЛ К”. This is a generic boundary error, but only one affected review row was observed, so its expected direct corpus value is limited. There is no new evidence for another branded-token suppression, threaded/inch semantic expansion, or manufacturer enrichment refinement: all three evaluated attempts raised hidden wrong-NOT_FOUND rates.
research_memory.decision_impact: The main decision is whether unresolved value is primarily lost inside the accepted alternate-query retrieval mechanism, or whether a substantial portion of the corpus is genuinely outside LD’s catalog scope and needs honest uncertainty. Do not infer that more semantic expansion is the bottleneck: repeated branded-query transformations were unsafe. A bounded experiment should discriminate evidence-preservation/fusion from non-catalog intent while retaining raw retrieval and guarding against wrong NOT_FOUND.

The local retrieval-normalization space is saturated: prior semantic expansion, branded-query genericization/enrichment, canonical-evidence preservation, variant fusion, and work/product decomposition all produced either no safe gain or increased wrong-NOT_FOUND. research_memory.question: What causal mechanisms remain credible after inspecting the champion, real-tender corpus, and experiment ledger for attempt 5?
research_memory.findings:
The live path retrieves raw text plus at most one canonical alternate, collapses alternate provenance within each modality, RRF-fuses a top-20, then asks DeepSeek to make a binary MATCHED/NOT_FOUND choice using only the raw tender line. The intact files reconstruct the intended review pool to 130 rows (253 minus 90 keyed labels minus 33 provisional rows). On the valid 130-row pool, 92 rows contain valve terms, 33 contain filter terms, 43 contain sampled brand/model cues, and 18 contain service-action cues. Eight rows have clear media/cartridge/water-treatment cues without valve terminology. Nearby behavior-changing retrieval work is saturated.
